name: trend-only-subsignals-10m-threshold-025
rationale: Cost-side hypothesis required by the warning rule, companion to trend-only-subsignals-60m-threshold-015 (2026-11-07 lead #2). Keeps trend-only weights and 600s spacing but raises allocation_threshold 0.15 -> 0.25 so the engine only acts on large target changes. Caveat: at 50k the lot floor sits at ~25-27% of the account and 0.26+ was measured (2026-09-16) to collapse to a single trade, so 0.25 is deliberately just under that cliff; if the 50k run is a 1-trade degenerate result, record it as untestable at the primary capital rather than as a verdict, and read the 500k/5M diagnostics.
code_change_summary: In TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs), set TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 0.25 to 1.0 and REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 1.0 to 0.0. After computing weight_sum, return None if weight_sum <= 0.0 (only reversion sub-signals present during partial warmup) so the result is never NaN. Update both constants' doc comments and add a NOTE naming this hypothesis. Update compute_btc_target_* unit tests' expected values where they legitimately change (rewrite, never delete, tests asserting reversion dominance) and add a regression test that an RSI-only IndicatorPoint returns None and a trend-only point returns the expected value. Run the trend-only-subsignals-10m-threshold-015 code (experiment/trend-only-subsignals-10m-threshold-015, 0d2c192) on the same window at all three capitals as an unregistered reference, plus both it and this variant at --fee-pct 0 --slippage-pct 0 at 500k to separate gross timing value from cost.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.

MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula or the aggregation expression; exactly two numeric constants change (TREND 0.25 -> 1.0 and REVERSION 1.0 -> 0.0). Because REVERSION becomes 0.0 the weighted-mean denominator can be zero when only RSI/%B are present (partial warmup): handle that by returning None when weight_sum <= 0.0, and document it.

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
